definitions.nativeSource: Latin Wiktionary (la.wiktionary), Victionarium Latinum, and Perseus Lewis & Short English glosses
definitions.policy: Every entry carries an English explanation. A native-language explanation is included whenever a cleared native lexicographic source supplies one; no native gloss is invented.

selection.coverageMethod: selected mapped tokens / all corpus tokens; a token with several candidate lemmas is counted once

examplesPolicy: Only public-domain translations from structurally audited works are shipped. Each example is a complete short sentence or semicolon clause with a source/target alignment check, at most 30 source and 35 target words. Advanced entries carry no examples.
